paragraphs: In the morning, review search-term reports and remove costly keywords that produce no conversions. At midday, work with creatives on landing-page copy and refine the first screen's value proposition. In the afternoon, check whether smart bidding is drifting and correct it manually. In the evening, review which keyword groups reduced CAC. At month's end, prepare a customer acquisition report.

In short: turn users' search terms into orders. Duties include selecting keywords, bidding, building landing pages, monitoring conversions, and using data for performance reviews. Combining strategic thinking with continuous monitoring, search marketing strategists work on the front line of customer acquisition.
